d:
Fejo drops his latest Malayalam Rap Song SICK, backed by irresistible Dappan Kuthu beats that make you move
Lyrics speak of the hunger to win, staying clean & rising without shortcuts
A mass-hero style entry from the Mallu Rapper - the kind you'd expect in a festival or action packed movie
Music Composition - Fejo
Vocals & Lyrics - Fejo
Beat Production - Jeffin Jestin
Kids Chorus - Fausteena Jose, Anchelose Jose, Jona Rose Jose
Additional Vocals - Sherdin Thomas
